finalText:
**Build passes now, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs, not noise, both from the bundler bump.

- [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) threw on `undefined` flags. New config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed to treat `undefined` as disabled.

Rest of the ~950-line output is deprecation and dedupe noise, unrelated.

Next: nothing, build finished clean.
